name: Silk Screens
headline: Silk Screen Printing for Bold Apparel and Promotional Work
shortDescription: Silk screen setup and printing support for apparel, bags, promotional materials, and repeatable graphics.
body: Silk screening is useful for sharper, more durable graphics on larger apparel and promotional runs.
The process can include artwork layout, film, screen preparation, colour planning, and the final screen print.

image.alt: Silk screen printing setup applying ink to a T-shirt.
image.prompt: A silk screen printing setup in a workshop, with a squeegee pulling ink across a screen frame onto a white T-shirt and a sharp abstract logo impression. Authentic sign-and-print shop visual, professional lighting, practical production detail, no readable text, no logos, no watermarks.
